lean_representation_note: as for the accepted classic global workload_bound validation: `sort` is `List.mergeSort` with the `decide (≤)` key, `nth elem s i` is `s.getD i elem`, `n.-1` is `n - 1`, `n.+2` is `n + 2`; `\sum_(i <- s) F i` is `sumSeq s F`; `\sum_(0 <= i < n) F i` is `∑ i ∈ Finset.Ico 0 n, F i`; `div_floor` is the classic `Prosa.Classic.Util.DivMod.div_floor`, `minn` is `min`; the jitter job/schedule notions as in the accepted classic global jitter certificates
